formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x2 → (∃ (x4 : Fin x1 → Bool) (x5 : Fin x1 → Bool), x2.eval (List.ofFn x4 ++ [Bool.false]) ≠ x2.eval (List.ofFn x5 ++ [Bool.false])) → (∃ (x5 : Fin x1 → Bool), x2.eval (List.ofFn x5 ++ [Bool.true]) ≠ x2.eval (List.ofFn x5 ++ [Bool.false])) → ∃ (x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x6 ∧ x6.size < x2.size ∧ ∀ (x7 : Fin x1 → Bool), x6.eval (List.ofFn x7 ++ [Bool.false]) = x2.eval (List.ofFn x7 ++ [Bool.false])
plain_statement: For any n: if an AND/OR/NOT fan-in-two circuit on n + 1 inputs is not constant with its last input fed false, and its value changes with its last input at some input, then a strictly smaller such circuit has the same function with the last input fed false.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate AND(x_0, x_1) computes its edge function
